verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows the RustDesk host displaying the currently connected peers, or offering a host-side control to disconnect a session or revoke a device. The closest items are Server Pro's audit logs and per-user/device-group access control. Those are a historical record and a centralized policy feature, not a live connection view or host-side disconnect/revoke, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the host shows who is connected right now, and I can disconnect or revoke a device from the host
